_note: `ratings` is the full list (rendered everywhere). `disabled_ratings` is the subset rendered as `(disabled)` — visible but unselectable (currently 5000# / 10000# while the API 6A flow is sorted out). `categories` groups ratings by their governing standard so dropdowns can show <optgroup> headers (ASME B16.5 / API 6A / EEMUA 144 / ASTM A269 instrument tubing). Single source of truth for both visibility and grouping — no code change to enable / disable / re-group a rating.
